# Morning Briefing ## 1. Highest‑Weight Open Items (Deadline: **Day 19, 23:59**) | Task | Action | Deadline | Nudge | |------|--------|----------|-------| | **Rewrite‑vs‑Append Ablation** |
  • Allocate **200 H100 GPU‑hrs** (out of 2400) for full‑scale runs.
  • Adopt **MemGPT virtual‑context paging** (8e3bb063) as the “naïve append” baseline.
  • Schedule ablation post‑Wednesday 11:00 lab meeting for 20 % faster turnaround.
  • Draft rebuttal snippet:
| EOD **Today** (GPU) | Verify allocation today | | | `Draft: Reviewer 2's concern is addressed by a rigorous rewrite‑vs‑append ablation. Results show rewrite improves Needle‑survival F1 by ~9 pts and prevents token‑budget blow‑up. Consolidation is added as an additional baseline; see Appendix B.` | | | | **Benchmark Integration with Maya** | Extend the agent‑memory benchmark (303fb425) to include a “sleep‑time rewrite” task; log performance metrics. | 30 min slot, **Thursday 14:00 lab meeting** | Share schema with Maya by noon | | **Consolidation Baseline** | Implement the periodic consolidation step from arXiv 0a553296 before applying rewrite; log effect on cross‑fact interference. | Merge request due **Tomorrow** | | ## 2. Next Steps - **GPU Allocation** – Submit 200 hrs request by **10 AM**. - **Implementation** – Hook MemGPT paging and consolidation into the rewrite pipeline; aim for a pilot run on 5 episodes by **12:00 PM**. - **Rebuttal** – Finalize and submit draft with the manuscript by **noon tomorrow**. ## 3. Overnight Idea > **Insight**: Initial runs show MemGPT paging alone yields gains similar to the rewrite. A **hybrid pipeline** (paging → on‑sleep consolidation → rewrite) could shave even more cross‑fact interference and boost downstream recall. Consider a quick prototype to quantify the extra benefit. ---
